enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Lie on back. Fall asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body and hair. Wrap towel. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Turn on induction cooker. Pour egg mixture into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Pick up fork. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat eggs. Turn off kettle. Pour boiled water into cup. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing breakfast dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plate. Scrape food scraps into trash. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Pick up fork. Place fork in dishwasher. Pick up cup. Empty cup into sink. Place cup in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Rinse cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workspace, turning on the desk lamp and computer, reviewing the day's program schedule and emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom 1. Sit on chair at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Press computer power button. Wait for computer to start. Enter password. Open email application. Click on inbox. Read first email. Reply to email. Delete spam. Open calendar. Check today's schedule. Open document. Review program details. Highlight important items. Save document. Close email. Close calendar.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on the computer: coordinating community programs, drafting outreach materials and replying to partner emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Type on keyboard. Move mouse. Click on document. Draft outreach material. Copy text. Paste text. Open email. Reply to partner email. Attach file. Send email. Open spreadsheet. Update program records. Save spreadsheet. Pick up phone. Dial number. Speak on phone. Hang up. Pick up water bottle. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break, heating food in the microwave and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch container. Open microwave door. Place container in microwave. Close microwave door. Press buttons to set time. Press start. Open microwave door. Take out container. Pick up fork. Walk to table. Sit down. Open container. Eat food. Pick up container. Walk to sink. Rinse container. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home on the computer: hosting online coordination calls and updating program records
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open video conferencing software. Click join meeting. Adjust headset. Speak into microphone. Listen. Take notes. Click mute. Click unmute. Share screen. Click on document. Scroll. Click on spreadsheet. Type data. Save. End call. Close software. Open email. Reply to email. Update calendar.

enriched_activities.activity: Logging off work, stretching and resting on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from desk. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Lean back. Close eyes. Breathe. Open eyes. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll. Lock phone. Put down phone. Lean back. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and oven, then eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Cut vegetables and meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off induction cooker. Open oven. Place tray in oven. Close oven. Set timer. Take out tray. Place food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room and tidying up after the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Open closet. Take out vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum across floor. Pull vacuum back. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wrap cord. Put vacuum back in closet. Pick up items on floor. Place items on shelf. Pick up pillows. Place pillows on sofa. Pick up remote. Place remote on table. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and drying off
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to warm. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with the TV and browsing on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Click on video. Watch. Like. Comment. Lock phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock. Check email. Lock phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, dimming the desk lamp and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Set alarm. Lock phone. Put down phone. Walk to desk. Turn desk lamp knob to dim. Turn off desk lamp. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Lie on back. Fall asleep.
